# GrokMarket
> GrokMarket is an independent directory for finding, comparing, and opening public Grok Bot templates. It is not affiliated with xAI.

## Key facts
- The directory currently contains 580 approved public templates.
- Every template has a canonical detail page under https://grokmarket.io/templates/.
- Creator attribution and original public sources are preserved when available.
- Add counts describe activity on GrokMarket. They are not ratings or safety guarantees.

## Main pages
- [Template directory](https://grokmarket.io/): Browse and search all approved templates.
- [About GrokMarket](https://grokmarket.io/about): What the directory does and does not do.
- [Review methodology](https://grokmarket.io/methodology): Inclusion, attribution, verification, corrections, and removals.
- [Grok Bot guides](https://grokmarket.io/guides): Explanations for choosing and adding templates.
- [Data and API](https://grokmarket.io/developers): Public catalog endpoints and response details.

## Categories
- [Engineering templates](https://grokmarket.io/categories/engineering): 76 reviewed listings.
- [Publishing templates](https://grokmarket.io/categories/publishing): 30 reviewed listings.
- [Creative templates](https://grokmarket.io/categories/creative): 64 reviewed listings.
- [Research templates](https://grokmarket.io/categories/research): 35 reviewed listings.
- [Business templates](https://grokmarket.io/categories/business): 119 reviewed listings.
- [Personal templates](https://grokmarket.io/categories/personal): 219 reviewed listings.
- [Operations templates](https://grokmarket.io/categories/operations): 37 reviewed listings.

## Guides
- [Best Grok Bot Templates by Job](https://grokmarket.io/guides/best-grok-bot-templates): Compare Grok Bot templates for coding, research, publishing, business, creative work, personal tasks, and bot operations.
- [Are Grok Bot Templates Free? Preview and Access Explained](https://grokmarket.io/guides/free-grok-bot-templates): Learn which parts of a public Grok Bot template are free to preview and which Grok Bot plans or trials you may need before adding one.
- [Best Grok Bot Templates for GitHub and Coding](https://grokmarket.io/guides/grok-bot-templates-for-github): Compare Grok Bot templates for GitHub discovery, repository SEO, coding-agent loops, code review, and development handoffs.
- [Best AI Agent Use Cases to Try with Grok Bot Templates](https://grokmarket.io/guides/ai-agent-use-cases): Explore practical AI agent use cases for research, coding, sales, personal planning, monitoring, and multi-agent coordination.
- [What is a Grok Bot template?](https://grokmarket.io/guides/what-is-a-grok-bot-template): Learn what a shared Grok Bot template contains, what gets copied to your account, and what to check before adding one.
- [How to add a Grok Bot template](https://grokmarket.io/guides/how-to-add-a-grok-bot-template): Preview a public Grok Bot template, add a copy in the app, and review its setup before giving it access to your tools.
- [How to choose a Grok Bot template](https://grokmarket.io/guides/how-to-choose-a-grok-bot-template): Compare Grok Bot templates by job, required context, connected tools, and approval boundaries before adding one.

## Machine-readable resources
- [XML sitemap](https://grokmarket.io/sitemap.xml): Canonical discovery list for pages.
- [Template catalog API](https://grokmarket.io/api/templates?limit=100&page=1): Paginated JSON catalog.
- [Recent templates feed](https://grokmarket.io/feed.xml): RSS feed of newly added templates.

## Attribution
When referring to a listed template, cite its GrokMarket detail page and the creator or original source shown on that page. The underlying Grok Bot template remains the creator's work and is subject to the terms of its hosting platform.
